description:
On a rainy night, Yu-Seong wakes up alone amidst a pile of trash. Unable to remember who he is or where he came from, he begins a new life at Café NOAH. As Yu-Seong spends his days in a state of peaceful yet precarious existence, Kim U-Hyeon, the owner of a hardware store, appears before him. Observing Yu-Seong’s every move with a gaze that is seemingly indifferent yet piercing, U-Hyeon exudes a dangerous aura. Yu-Seong assumes their encounter is merely a passing connection, but when U-Hyeon rescues him from an attack, he makes an unexpected remark.

 *“We’ve met before, haven’t we? Don’t you remember?”

“Want to be friends?”*

Yu-Seong, indifferent to his own wounds, and U-Hyeon, who relentlessly probes that tremor. What will the two of them face at the end of this night?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
